system.description:
Battle Amp

Your Body radiates light so intensely, it becomes imperceivable as you radiate an aura closer to that of a blackholes. For the duration you gain the following benefits. You gain additional benefits based on the number of Starlight’s consumed.

Stellar Presence. Creatures within 40 feet of you cannot gain the benefits of being invisible you gain immunity to the Blinded and Dazzled conditions.

Transcendent Charge. At the beginning of each of your turns, you can summon 2 Starlight’s instead of one.

Infinite Horizon. Once per round, on your turn, you can gain 2 Stellar Charges, from any one trigger of your choice.

Starlight’s Consumed

1 Starlight. Up to twice per turn, on your turn, by spending 10 feet of movement or by spending a reaction at the beginning of other creatures turn, you can teleport to one active Starlight, into a space affected by the Starlight’s light.

2 Starlight’s. Convergence can now trigger on any damage, regardless of the effects keyword. Select the effect you want to apply when its triggered, even if its triggered by another creature.

3 Starlight’s. All active Starlight’s can enter Fusion of Fission. If you choose to do this, All creatures that are Converged are teleported into a space of your choice, as close to a Starlight as possible.

4 Starlight’s. You can maintain Starlight Fission’s or Fusions, for the duration of your Event Horizon, instead of them detonating at the beginning of your next turn.
system.summary: Nothing within 40 feet is invisible, and you're immune to Blinded and Dazzled. Extra Starlights and Stellar Charges, plus benefits for each Starlight consumed.

rules.text: Start: Bonus action, 4 Stellar Charges, and consume up to 4 Starlights (their benefits stack by count).
